reason: Hendrik Johannes Nel is the same two given names as Johannes Hendrik in reversed order. He is in the same Uitenhage district, and C01 Willem s Louis is a clearly different name.
No Somerset owner is named Johannes Petrus. The only Johannes is C03, recorded in Uitenhage with no middle name and father Matthys, which is too weak given the different district.
Johannes Abraham Landman of Uitenhage matches the full given names and the declared district exactly. The other candidates have different given names.
No Vermaak owner is named Izaak Cornelis Johannes or anything close. Every candidate's given names clearly differ.
C02 has the matching name Jacobus Frederik in Beaufort but is recorded as a widow's claim. Nothing shows the claim is his own, and C01 Martinus Jacobus has a different first name.
No owner is named Johannes Cornelis Vermaak. The Johannes candidates have different second names (Gerhardus, Adrianus, Rynier), and the Cornelis candidate is Cornelis Tobias.
The only candidate, Hermanus Johannes Pieterse, has given names clearly different from Nicolaas Theodorus.
None of the 24 Venter owners is named Christiaan or Willem Christiaan. All given names differ clearly from Christiaan Willem.
The candidates, Jacobus Johannes s Jacob and Petrus Lafras, have names clearly different from Cornelis Janse. No Cornelis Janse Uys appears among the Uitenhage owners.
C07 Johannes Gerhardus Uys of Swellendam matches the name and district but is noted as son of Cornelis. The genealogy gives his father as Johannes Gerhardus, a strong parentage contradiction.
